description: To prepare for establishing permanent human settlements on the Moon and sending crews to Mars, space agencies (like NASA and ESA) rely heavily on planetary analogs—Earth locations that mimic specific geological, environmental, or atmospheric conditions of these celestial bodies.
summary:
* Simulated Butterfly & Signal Duty: The model starts with a "simulated butterfly" block and a "Signal Duty" block generating a control or duty cycle signal.
 * AI Chip: The signal is processed through an "AI CHIP" block.
 * TX & RX Block: Outputs from the AI chip feed into a transmitter and receiver ("TX & RX") block, which interfaces with a display and magnetic/inductive components.
 * Inductive / Transformer Components: There are coupled inductor/transformer coils (M_t) with series resistors (R_r).
 * Battery + Motor + System: On the right side, the circuit connects to a subsystem labeled "BATTERY+MOTOR+S".
 * Scope & Display: A "Scope1" and "Display 25" are used to monitor signals and outputs from the system.
